status.summary: The October 14 bidder-ranking notice confirms Tongji’s 2026 Siping data-centre room works are at the procurement stage. Shanghai Beiding Information Technology is the first-ranked bidder, subject to objections. The proposed fit-out has no confirmed construction-start or opening date.

locator.precision: Representative point inside the community-mapped Tongji University East Campus. It locates the parent campus for the A-building room works, not Building A, a machine-room footprint, an entrance, construction boundary or official surveyed parcel.
locator.identity_review: The September22 original university tender explicitly names Tongji East Campus Building A at1230 Siping Road. The official gate directory identifies1230 Siping Road as the East Campus main entrance and separately identifies1239 Siping Road as the main Siping campus entrance. Native OSM way871639330 bears the exact East Campus name. The selected point is derived from that named campus polygon, rather than from the purchaser’s1239 address. The older Siping centre’s room location remains unknown; its historical operation is not assigned to this2026 works project. No building alias or map boundary is asserted to be an official parcel.
locator.uncertainty_reason: OSM gives no measured horizontal accuracy or verified displacement to Building A or its first-floor room; source precision is not survey precision.

additions.distinctness_review: All451projects,425sites,2291evidence and231original records screened. No selectedsource URL/hash collision or baseline geometry envelope/polygon overlap. Nearest existing marker is PBOC Shanghai Zhenguang Road Data Centre at12195.11m. Identity matches are retained in tongji-dedup.json for review. Jiading, Lingang and the purchaser’s1239 main-campus address are excluded from this East Campus locator.
additions.successor_review: The original university October14 notice is candidate ranking, not a final award despite its site-navigation category. Original September22 tender fixes scope to East Campus A,floor1,1230SipingRoad. The2024 university cloud article establishes a historically existing Siping centre but no building or2026 room relationship; no old operational status or Jiadingcapacity is transferred. A separate equipment notice uses a different building label at the same address/floor/areas; no alias or extra facility is inferred. Bounded exact-title and site-domain checks found no later achieved start, completion or opening.

additions.name: Mirai Ogaki Data Center Campus Existing Operations

locator.precision: Operator-embedded Google named-property point at Mirai Ogaki No.1, Kagano 4-1-12. This labels the adjacent MiraiDC campus, whose No.2 facility is across the road. It is not a campus polygon, individual data-hall footprint or separate No.2 building locator.
locator.identity_review: Operator specification page 1 explicitly names Mirai Ogaki No.1 Data Center at Kagano 4-1-12; its parking notice independently repeats that address and places No.2 directly across the road. The current official facilities index groups both under MiraiDC. The operator access page embeds this exact named Google property; original embed response associates its feature ID, address, selected coordinates and operator website. The page viewport coordinate is excluded. This is one adjacent named campus with its marker on No.1, not an assumed office-only location.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The mapping service supplies no measured positional accuracy; coordinate decimal precision does not imply survey accuracy.

status.summary: The operator president describes existing Ogaki colocation, hosting and network services. September 29 is the article publication date; interview day is unknown. This is a campus-level operating observation, not a new opening or separate utilization report for each building.

additions.distinctness_review: All 425 current sites, 451 projects, 2291 evidence rows and 231 original source records screened across all serialized fields and aliases, plus identity mapping and original spatial coordinates. No candidate identity matches, source collisions or geometry envelopes containing the marker. Nearest site: EdgeConneX Greater Osaka campus (Kagoya Tatara Campus, Kyotanabe), 100,451.8 metres.
additions.successor_review: One campus-level record for the operator’s adjacent Ogaki No.1 and No.2 properties. The fresh interview describes the current Ogaki business collectively and does not separately refresh each building’s specifications. Future expansion or refurbishment must be separately evidenced at this campus.
